WITH sma_10004_cte AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', activity_date) AS metric_time__month
    , member_id AS __monthly_paid_buyer_count
    , 1 AS __monthly_paid_order_count
    , net_sales_cents AS __monthly_paid_sales_cents
    , CASE WHEN monthly_order_count >= 2 THEN member_id END AS __monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count
  FROM "data"."main"."paid_member_month_orders" paid_member_month_orders_src_10000
)

SELECT
  MAX(subq_10.monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count) AS monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count
  , MAX(subq_17.monthly_paid_repeat_rate) AS monthly_paid_repeat_rate
  , MAX(subq_17.monthly_paid_avg_order_value) AS monthly_paid_avg_order_value
FROM (
  SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count) AS monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count
  FROM sma_10004_cte
  WHERE metric_time__month BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
) subq_10
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT
    CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_paid_buyer_count), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS monthly_paid_repeat_rate
    , CAST(SUM(__monthly_paid_sales_cents) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(__monthly_paid_order_count), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS monthly_paid_avg_order_value
  FROM sma_10004_cte
  WHERE metric_time__month BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
) subq_17
answer: 青禾 2026 年 8 月（完整自然月，全渠道、全门店，按 CRM 会员账户统计）月末付费会员复购人数为 4 人，月末付费会员复购率为 66.67%，月末付费会员订单均额为 47.55 元/单。口径为：按 2026 年 8 月底最后一天判断付费资格，账户名下至少一张悦享年卡或家庭季卡有效；异业联名卡、体验卡不计入，同一账户多张有效卡不重复计人、不重复累计订单。复购人数指同月至少有两笔有效订单的不同账户数；复购率为复购人数除以月末付费会员购买人数；订单均额为月末付费会员净销售额除以有效订单数。本次为本周期合成测试库结果。
